title: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson

entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A young Temur hunter and twin of Baishya who first confronts the wounded stranger Tae Jin.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A young whisperer and twin of Naiva who recognizes Tae Jin's words from her vision.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The former chief of the Temur and grandmother of the twins, a healer and keeper of the past, who leads the party toward Ugin's grave.

entities.name: Fec
entities.description: A Kolaghan-born orc with a bad leg and two swords who travels with the hunting party and keeps watch.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A young Jeskai student of a master who seeks Yasova to share the Spirit Dragon's story and is sentenced to death by Ojutai's broodling.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon whose first-person account Tae Jin recites, about being born twinned with Nicol and what became of him; he says the one he loved best killed him.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Ugin's twin, who burns with desire for revenge on humans, takes the second name Bolas, and manipulates humans into murder.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: A metallic-scaled elder dragon, a scholar of creatures who lives by a lake and sends the twins away.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: A reddish-green elder dragon who hunts and scorns the twins as runts.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: A white elder dragon who rules a human colony as Dragonlord and teaches the humans law and order.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: A big, ugly dragon who guards a territory with his siblings and chases the twins.

entities.name: Te Ju Ki
entities.description: An old holy elder at Arcades's colony who teaches Ugin about planes and cycles of life and death.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A Dragonlord and scholar who began the purges and destroyed records; he commands the sentence against Tae Jin.

entities.name: Ojutai's broodling
entities.description: A pale gray-white dragon of Ojutai's brood that tracks Tae Jin and sentences him to die by ice through its aven translator.

entities.name: Aven interpreter
entities.description: An aven in an elaborate vest who translates the broodling's draconic.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The Dragonlord whose territory the party crosses; she would eat Baishya if she suspected she was a whisperer.

entities.name: Atarka's broodling
entities.description: A dragon that has followed the party for days and then vanishes.

entities.name: The Temur
entities.description: Yasova's clan, whose whisperers are said to create ice doubles.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: The people to whom Tae Jin belongs, who keep Ugin's story as oral tradition.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: A mountain range the party crossed before reaching the high plateau.

entities.name: The high plateau
entities.description: The treacherous open land on Tarkir where the party travels toward Ugin's grave.

entities.name: Ugin's grave
entities.description: The destination of Yasova's party.

entities.name: Eternal Peak
entities.description: The mountain where an avalanche nearly killed the twins.

entities.name: Rakhan
entities.description: A hunter who takes watch.

entities.name: Sorya
entities.description: A hunter who takes watch.

entities.name: Arcades's colony
entities.description: A walled riverside human city ruled by Arcades Sabboth.

events.summary: Yasova's party sees an Ojutai dragon hunting on the high plateau, and Yasova decides to avoid it on the way to Ugin's grave.
events.quote: I want to reach Ugin's grave without tangling with that dragon.

events.summary: Yasova praises Naiva and sends her and Baishya to scout a ring of stones where vultures are perched.
events.quote: If the vultures are not afraid, then we need not be.

events.summary: Naiva is attacked in the rock ring by a wounded stranger; she disarms him and he faints after asking for Yasova Dragonclaw.
events.quote: You are of the Temur clan. I seek Yasova Dragonclaw.

events.summary: Yasova suspects a trap by Ojutai's broodling but Naiva and Baishya insist she heal him.
events.quote: This could be a trap on the part of Ojutai to find me.

events.summary: Tae Jin explains his master's dream and that Ojutai destroyed records but the Spirit Dragon's story survives by oral tradition.
events.quote: He wants to destroy our memory of the past, and of our ancestors

events.summary: Yasova heals Tae Jin's wound with magic and tells him to prove his words.
events.quote: She pulled off her glove and placed a bare hand, fingers spread, atop the wound.

events.summary: Tae Jin recites the words of Ugin, who says the one he loved best in all the worlds is the one who killed him.
events.quote: The one I loved best in all the worlds is the one who killed me.

events.summary: Flashback in Ugin's words: he and Nicol learn that no creature is safe after witnessing their sister's death and set out to find their siblings.
events.quote: We witnessed the death of a sister, and in this way, we learned that no creature is safe.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol insists they should have interfered to stop the hunters and wants to learn how to destroy them.
events.quote: I want to know who those hunters are, and where they come from, and how we can destroy them.

events.summary: Flashback: the twins meet Chromium Rhuell by a lake, who dismisses them and sends them to Palladia-Mors.
events.quote: But for now, go away, little ones.

events.summary: Flashback: Palladia-Mors scorns the twins as runts and flings a corpse at them.
events.quote: You're so small, the two of you. Little runts.

events.summary: Flashback: Ugin sees nothing wasted in the cycle of life and death, while Nicol wants to kill something.
events.quote: I want to kill something,

events.summary: Flashback: the twins spend years perfecting tandem hunting, and meet Vaevictis Asmadi's territory.
events.quote: We spent years, as you Jeskai would measure the span of days, perfecting various techniques for hunting in tandem.

events.summary: Flashback: the twins find Arcades Sabboth ruling a human settlement.
events.quote: To our surprise our sibling Arcades Sabboth had taken up residence inside the great ring wall.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol burns a tower and soldiers when humans shoot at the twins, and Arcades slams into him.
events.quote: His blast of fire breath scorched along the highest tower and its adjoining wall walk.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol takes the name Nicol Bolas and the twins are admitted to the colony as Arcades's guests.
events.quote: I am Nicol Bolas,

events.summary: Flashback: the twins live for years in the colony, Ugin befriending the holy elder Te Ju Ki.
events.quote: I poked my snout into everything, and made particular friends with an old holy elder named Te Ju Ki

events.summary: Flashback: Te Ju Ki shows Ugin globes of light she calls planes and teaches that death is part of endless cycles.
events.quote: She called each one a "plane," although I did not know what she meant by the word at that time.

events.summary: Flashback: one man stabs his brother in a sudden quarrel after years of peace, and Nicol watches with satisfaction.
events.quote: Nicol lounged there, stretched along the ridgeline, watching the scene with an avid gaze.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol tells Ugin he has found a better way to avenge their sister and flies off without farewells.
events.quote: I have discovered a better way to get revenge.

events.summary: Flashback: Arcades dismisses Ugin's concerns, and Ugin leaves Te Ju Ki to follow Nicol.
events.quote: I know where he's going. I must follow him.

events.summary: An Ojutai broodling appears and its aven interpreter sentences Tae Jin to die by ice for sacrilege.
events.quote: Tae Jin, by the command of the Great Teacher, you are accused of the crime of sacrilege and sentenced to die by ice.

relations.quote: I was born twinned to Nicol, where in every other egg there was only one.

relations.note: Ugin's words were passed down to Tae Jin's Jeskai ancestors
relations.quote: These are the words of Ugin Spirit Dragon, who spoke them in ancient days to one of my Jeskai ancestors.

relations.note: teaches him meditation with globes of light
relations.quote: Do you wish me to teach you how to create the globes and spin them?

relations.note: Ojutai sentences Tae Jin to die by ice
relations.quote: by the command of the Great Teacher, you are accused of the crime of sacrilege

relations.note: carries out the Great Teacher's command
relations.quote: An Ojutai broodling? No. They're too intelligent to do anything by mistake.
Grandmother has her reasons for everything she does.
If Atarka ever suspects you are a whisperer, she'll eat you.
as our older brother, Arcades, circled back around for another attack.
